title: The Use of a Smartphone EEG in Adults With Epilepsy
official: Enabling Point of Care Diagnosis of Epilepsy in Underserved Populations
summary: In this prospective, open-label, single-arm, dual-institution trial, the investigators aim to develop a general-purpose AI able to identify epilepsy and type of epilepsy in EEG to facilitate the epilepsy diagnosis using smartphone EEG in resource-limited settings.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older,
* Able to provide consent or have a next of kin proxy provide consent,
* Seen by a neurologist at Northwestern Memorial Hospital or Ignace Deen Hospital,
* In the USA, has a primary care physician at the recruiting hospital (NMH) and seen twice, in the past 5 years on the medical record,
* Has a history of at least one unprovoked seizure, not attributable to any other obvious cause,
* Diagnosis of epilepsy or question of the diagnosis of epilepsy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide informed consent or have proxy consent provided,
* Clinical moribund or acutely unwell,
* Intoxicated or suspected substance or medication overuse or abuse leading to provoked seizure,
* Unable to follow up with the investigative team in the 2 years following enrollment,
* Unable to tolerate a survey or EEG. For any reason including attentional deficits, open skull defect, scalp infection, or any other reason,
* Unable to participate or complete study procedures as determined by the supervising study physician investigator for any other cause not listed above.
